summary: Tested iter51 fixes: ConversationComposer duplicate export, live_location_routes import fix, feedback admin notifications. 8/9 backend tests pass. Frontend compiles, loads, auth works for all 3 roles. Inbox works. ONE composer visible (no duplicate). Live location button visible and enabled for TP when HO has shared address.

critical.issue: Admin notifications for new feedback/issues are NOT visible in admin panel. Root cause: feedback_routes.py stores notification user_id as ObjectId (a['_id'] from db.users query), but misc_routes.get_notifications queries by string user['_id']. Mismatch causes notifications to be invisible. Fix: wrap with str() → `'user_id': str(a['_id'])` in the insert_many call in feedback_routes.py lines 94-105.

action_items: Fix feedback_routes.py admin notification user_id storage: change `'user_id': a['_id']` to `'user_id': str(a['_id'])` in the insert_many call (around line 97) so notifications are queryable by string user_id

rca_of_issue.issue: Admin notifications for feedback/issues not visible
rca_of_issue.root_cause: feedback_routes.py stores notification user_id as ObjectId from `db.users.find({'role':'admin'}, {'_id':1})` result. misc_routes.get_notifications queries by string user['_id'] (auth.py converts _id to string). MongoDB won't match ObjectId vs string.
rca_of_issue.fix: In feedback_routes.py, change the insert_many calls to use str(a['_id']) instead of a['_id'] for user_id field (around lines 94-105)
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Submit feedback/issue as any user, then check admin notifications panel - shows 0 notifications
